title: Θεραπευτικά (12 books), Περὶ πυρετῶν, Περὶ ἑλμίνθων — Therapeutics, On Fevers, Letter on Intestinal Worms; RU: Александр Траллийский, «Терапевтика»
author: Alexander of Tralles
size: 12 books plus two short works; est. 120–150k words (Puschmann, 2 vols, c. 1,200 pp. with facing German)
edition: Puschmann, Alexander von Tralles, 2 vols, Wien 1878–79 (Greek and German; repr. 1963), public domain; Nachträge 1886. Scans via BSB digital collections.
ru_evidence: No ru.wikipedia article; absent from ΣΧΟΛΗ index and from Balalykin's Galen series; no Russian version found anywhere.
en_evidence: en, de and fr Wikipedia list only Puschmann (German) and Brunet (French); Langslow 2006 studies the Latin version. No English translation found.
other_translations: German: Puschmann 1878–79. French: Brunet, 4 vols, 1933–37. German excerpts of iatromagic: Grimm-Stadelmann 2020.
value: Last great original clinician of Late Antiquity (brother of Anthemius, architect of Hagia Sophia): case observations, open critique of Galen, amulets and iatromagical remedies. Heavily used in Latin, Arabic and Hebrew medicine. For historians of medicine, magic, Byzantium.
ai_feasibility: high for prose (clear didactic Koine); medium for drug names; Puschmann and Brunet allow cross-checking. Amulet formulas need specialist review.
pilot_unit: Letter on Intestinal Worms (est. c. 4k words) plus Therapeutics I chapters on melancholy and epilepsy (est. c. 8k)
